source: DECA Guide 2026-27, Integrated Marketing Campaign Events, Presentation Evaluation Form (pp. 107-108)

categories.name: Knowledge of Industry/Brand
categories.official: Clear, thorough understanding of the industry, the organization, product or service, and its position within its industry.

categories.name: Business Opportunity
categories.official: Explains the business opportunity, goals and objectives, and the target market.

categories.name: Research, Insights and Connection to Campaign
categories.official: Explains the research method, results, and how the findings inform the next steps.

categories.name: Campaign Strategy
categories.official: Proposes feasible ideas and solutions based on data and analysis that effectively solves the business opportunity using creativity and innovative ideas/concepts.

categories.name: Campaign Activities and Schedule
categories.official: Outlines actionable strategic activities with realistic timelines, and aligns target market(s), channels and activities.

categories.name: Proposed Budget
categories.official: Justifies campaign costs, identifies key expenses, and addresses financial viability.

categories.name: Impact and Measurement
categories.official: Proposes relevant metrics/key indicators to capture and measure the results and effectiveness of the campaign.

categories.name: Organization
categories.official: Information is presented in a logical sequence that can be easily followed and understood.

categories.name: Effectiveness
categories.official: Presentation effectively persuades, informs, or inspires by communicating a clear message.

categories.name: Delivery
categories.official: Presentation engages the audience through interactive techniques (e.g., visual storytelling, etc.).

categories.name: Presentation Design
categories.official: Visual aids and themes are used throughout and are appropriate, professional, and add value to the presentation.

categories.name: Overall Impression
categories.official: Demonstrates overall career readiness through professionalism, poise and confidence.

auto_caps._note: Applied by scripts/score.py from deck.json facts. A grader cannot score above these caps.

research_no_primary.rule: No completed primary research (survey with n>=30 or >=3 interviews).

research_unlinked.rule: Fewer than 3 research findings [R#] are cited on strategy slides.

budget_thin.rule: Fewer than 5 budget lines, or no projected revenue.

impact_no_targets.rule: Any KPI is missing a target.

design_no_visuals.rule: Fewer than 8 body slides (4-19) have a visual.

delivery_no_talk_track.rule: No talk track notes on body slides (delivery cannot be judged from slides alone).

harsh_guidance._note: Grader must apply these in addition to the official bands.
harsh_guidance.industry_knowledge: 5 requires company facts with dates, product specifics, and a competitor or category position. Generic category description = max 3.
harsh_guidance.business_opportunity: 5 requires a specific structural problem (channel gap, revenue mix, new market) plus SMART objectives. 'Low awareness' alone = max 3.
harsh_guidance.research: 15 requires stated methods with n and dates, results shown, and every major campaign decision traced to a finding ('finding -> therefore'). Secondary data only = max 5 (auto-capped).
harsh_guidance.strategy: 15 requires one big idea that directly solves the stated problem, built on cited findings, with at least one element a competitor could not copy. Generic 'influencers + UGC + ads' = max 8.
harsh_guidance.activities: 15 requires a week-by-week schedule within 45 days where every activity names its segment, channel, objective, and owner/week. Missing segment-channel alignment = max 10.
harsh_guidance.budget: 10 requires line items with cost basis (quote, benchmark source, or labeled assumption), totals that sum, revenue projection from funnel math, profit-based ROI, and a conservative case. Revenue-based 'ROI' without margin = max 8.
harsh_guidance.impact: 10 requires each objective mapped to KPI, baseline, target, tracking tool (UTM, promo code, QR, brand-lift survey), and check cadence. Vanity metrics only = max 5.
harsh_guidance.organization: 5 requires official outline order, one idea per slide, consistent navigation.
harsh_guidance.effectiveness: 5 requires a one-sentence thesis stated at the open and close, and a persuasive through-line.
harsh_guidance.delivery: Score from talk-track notes and planned interactive elements (handout, prop, phone mockup walkthrough). Without them, auto-capped at 3.
harsh_guidance.design: 5 requires mockups on most body slides, 40-110 words per slide, one visual system. Text-only slides = max 2.
harsh_guidance.overall: Score from professionalism of language and completeness of the deck as a client pitch.
